# Hello World PowerShell Script

Here are a few ways to write a "Hello World" script in PowerShell:

## Basic Version

```powershell
Write-Host "Hello, World!"
```

## Using Write-Output

```powershell
Write-Output "Hello, World!"
```

## As a Complete Script File (.ps1)

Save this as `HelloWorld.ps1`:

```powershell
#!/usr/bin/env pwsh
# HelloWorld.ps1 - A simple Hello World script

Write-Host "Hello, World!" -ForegroundColor Green
```

## How to Run

1. **In PowerShell terminal:**
   ```powershell
   .\HelloWorld.ps1
   ```

2. **Or run directly:**
   ```powershell
   powershell -File HelloWorld.ps1
   ```

> **Note:** If you get an execution policy error, you may need to run:
> ```powershell
> Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Scope CurrentUser
> ```
